title: Styling in Large Monorepos knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Styling in Large Monorepos?
options: It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
professional styling needs intentional architecture, repeatable checks and clear trade-offs
questions.answer_key: professional styling needs intentional architecture, repeatable checks and clear trade-offs
questions.explanation: Styling in Large Monorepos is best understood through the syllabus topics: Multiple application entry points, Shared component packages, Source detection across workspaces. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with styling in large monorepos?
options: Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
make a minimal reproduction, document decisions and test representative combinations
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
questions.answer_key: make a minimal reproduction, document decisions and test representative combinations
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Multiple application entry points, Shared component packages, Source detection across workspaces, Shared theme and utility definitions.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying styling in large monorepos?
options: Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
a local example does not prove shared-theme or monorepo integration is complete
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
questions.answer_key: a local example does not prove shared-theme or monorepo integration is complete
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
